{{Short description|Indian palynologist}}

'''Parameswaran Krishnan Kutty Nair''' (February 6, 1930, in [[Perunna]] – January 21, 2017, in [[Bangalore]]) was an Indian [[palynologist]], best remembered for his work in plant reproductive biology, and on the triphyletic theory of origin and evolution of [[angiosperm]]s. He served as the founding director of the Environment Resources Research Centre. He was considered the "Father of Indian Palynology".<ref>{{cite news |title=PKK Nair passes away: Botanical scientist P K K Nair dead |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/thiruvananthapuram/botanical-scientist-p-k-k-nair-dead/articleshow/56722262.cms |access-date=23 March 2022 |work=The Times of India |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Garg |first1=Arti |title=P.
